summary: ArcBest Corporation filed an 8-K on July 24, 2026, announcing that its Board of Directors approved a quarterly cash dividend of $0.12 per share. The dividend is payable on August 21, 2026, to shareholders of record as of August 7, 2026. This is a routine capital allocation decision, not a special situation. There are no deal terms, advisors, or structural mechanics. No activist, strategic review, or restructuring is involved. This filing does not warrant further risk-arb analysis.
